Overview

Khasab is a city in Musandam with a population of 25,000. The capital of the Musandam Peninsula, a stunning fjord-like enclave on the Strait of Hormuz, known as the Norway of Arabia for its dramatic coastline. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
